03

 

Engage in a variety of enriching activities designed to promote holistic well-being, creativity, and stress relief. our Offerings cater to diverse interests and needs, providing participants with valuable tools for personal growth and emotional balance.

 

EVERY THING

YOU CAN GET

FROM THE FESTIVAL

Yoga + Meditation

A holistic approach to physical and mental well-being, blending the physical postures and breathing techniques of yoga with the mindfulness and inner calm of meditation.

Suicide Wall of Rememberance

A poignant and solemn tribute dedicated to the memory of those who have lost their lives to suicide.

Plant-making

Learning the art of plant propagation by creating a terrarium or plant arrangement.

Sauna + Swimming

Immersion in the soothing embrace of nature's waters.

On-site therapists + Rage room

Our team of psychologists will be available throughout the event to provide counselling and support.

Painting & Pottery

Exploring the creative side in painting and pottery workshops.

Tai Chi Sauna

Involves a series of slow, flowing movements and postures. The practice is designed to enhance physical strength, flexibility, balance, and mental focus.

Marketplace

Various vendors and buyers will come together to exchange goods and services.
